description: Initialization: Construct by earliest completion and run first-improvement re-timing descent. Make a total of 8 times the number of inserted tasks in random single-task perturbation attempts, followed by descent when a feasible choice is found; retain the best total adjacent transformation time. Use the supplied random generator.

Reassignment: Remove released observations and apply the same rule to reconsidered tasks. Re-timing can change only observations inserted during this call; other observations stay fixed. Return no change if the complete timeline is unchanged or infeasible.
